the steroid dependency of hypothalamus oxytocin binding is a characteristic of the ventromedially placed oxytocin binding site in the rat, and not a characteristic of the oxytocin binding system as a whole.

oxytocin is an important neurotransmitter and that its effects are mediated by specific neuronal receptors that are present throughout the brain.
